summary: Recorder spool scans stay idle across symlinked macOS temporary directories without losing receipt publication wakes.

replay.detail: Receipt ingestion and claim replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Watch roots are resolved before registration. Root folder creation and generic, access-time or extended-attribute metadata events no longer queue scans; child changes, root ownership or permission changes, root rename/removal, unknown events and rescan requests remain actionable.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous watcher event filter; receipt files and retry deadlines are unchanged.
